record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add label smoothing of 0.02 to the existing full-vocabulary masked-item cross-entropy, retaining temperature 0.8 and uniform weighting over masked targets. Mild smoothing may reduce overconfident item discrimination without the strong positional bias introduced by the regressed final-target weighting trial. Preserve masked-target sampling, embeddings, topology, scoring, readout, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Train and load exactly one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Apply label smoothing of 0.02 to masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets to test whether mild regularization improves ranking. Retain temperature 0.8 and uniform masked-target weighting. Architecture, sampling, optimization and inference remain unchanged; checkpoint and predictor changes are unnecessary.
